verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local, single-file LLM runtime with no hosted account or data-storage layer where a user's data accumulates in a proprietary format — models run fully offline using open GGUF weights already on the user's own disk. There is nothing analogous to a SaaS 'export and leave' feature for this kind of product, so the axis is a category mismatch rather than an unmet capability.
